Step 4: Recognize the patched code as safe -> Shaky; models kept flagging the fix

scenes.screen_title: Which loop are we talking about? / If it learns, every lesson is a release
scenes.visual_summary: System diagram categorizing AI execution loops (Inside model, Around model, Across experiments) and illustrating continuous learning release management (Log -> Curate -> Adapt -> Gate -> Promote).
ocr_details: WHAT'S NEXT
Which loop are we talking about?
Inside the model: A model trained to run its own layers again (more depth, same weights).
Around the model: Tools, retries, planning, more agents (same model, more calls).
Across experiments: Change code or weights, evaluate, keep or reject (the compiler agents did this to an engine).
All three spend compute. Only the third keeps what it learned.
If it learns, every lesson is a release: Log -> Curate -> Adapt -> Gate -> Promote

spoken_segments.text: We have loops inside models, loops around models, loops across experiments.
If it learns, every lesson is a release: Log, Curate, Adapt, Gate, Promote. Give it a version, a gate and a way back.
